title: My account
intro: Your access to the admin: password, two-factor sign-in and where you are signed in.
error: Your account could not be loaded

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.managed: An Owner or Admin changes name, address and roles in the team.

password.title: Change password
password.body: After the change every other session ends; this one stays signed in.
password.done: Password changed. Every other session has ended.

errors.new: The new password needs at least :min characters.
errors.confirmation: The two passwords do not match.

two_factor.title: Two-factor sign-in
two_factor.rotate_body: For a new phone or another app. Your current code keeps working until you confirm the new one.
two_factor.code_hint: Six digits from your authenticator app.
two_factor.new_code_hint: Six digits the new app shows now.
two_factor.scan: Scan the QR code with the new app or enter the key.
two_factor.qr_alt: QR code for the authenticator app
two_factor.expires: Valid until :time. After that you start again.
two_factor.done: Authenticator changed. Every other session has ended.
two_factor.pending: A change was started and is valid until :time. The key is shown only once: start again or cancel.

errors.failed: That did not work. Try again.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.body: With a recovery code you sign in when your phone is missing. Each code works once. Showing them needs a current code.
recovery.regenerate_body: The old codes stop working, and every other session ends.
recovery.list_hint: Keep them somewhere safe, not on the same phone. They disappear when you leave the page.
recovery.new_done: New codes created. The old ones no longer work.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.body: Where your account is signed in right now.
sessions.end_others_body: Every other sign-in of your account ends at once. This one stays.
sessions.end_body: The session on :device ends at once.
